_readme: S454 SkyBlazingStar, 2026-10-23. Of Hartnell's 96 extracted records (run 39895340003), 41 degrees fail the arithmetic check only because the record names the degree total and a general education pattern (Cal-GETC 28, Local GE 13) without its units; the Requirements tab prints the pattern's name and no units. A reconcile step can set the pattern's units from the catalog's own words, as Monterey Peninsula, Taft and Cañada's steps do. This read searches the front of the 2026-2027 catalog PDF (427 pages, generated 2026-08-21) for the sentences that state each pattern's units. No model call. Run 39930823888: the catalog states no unit figure for Cal-GETC (page 58 lists its areas only); its Hartnell College Local General Education prints area by area on PDF page 58 (Area 1 6 units required; Areas 2, 3 and 4 3 units required each) and runs onto page 59. This read prints pages 58 and 59 whole for the remaining areas and any total.

outside_hosts.amazonaws.com: Coursedog's public bucket for generated catalog PDFs (coursedog-pdfs-public-prod.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com), linked from Hartnell's catalog page as Download Catalog as PDF.

questions.ge_units: How many units the catalog states for Cal-GETC and for Hartnell's local general education pattern (the associate degree's GE), in its own words, and on which page.
